subject: Trading
title: The 2008 Financial Crisis
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The 2008 Financial Crisis.

hook.text: Lehman Brothers collapsed on September 15, 2008. The world's financial system nearly died that week.

buildup.text: Banks had packaged risky subprime mortgages into complex bonds, sold them globally, and called them 'safe.'

discovery.text: When homeowners defaulted, the bonds collapsed. Banks that held trillions in these bonds faced insolvency.

twist.text: The crisis started in U.S. housing and spread to every corner of global finance. No one was safe.

climax.text: The S&P 500 fell 57% from peak to trough. Governments spent trillions on bailouts to prevent total collapse.

punchline.text: When complex instruments fail, simplicity is the survivor.
